prompts.text: Bug fix for Brett. Read CLAUDE.md + _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md first. Finished headless builds never close their tmux session: deploy/claude-headless.sh waits for Enter (up to a day) after `claude -p` ends, so 35 finished `axf-*` sessions piled up and the agent cap / build queue counted them as busy and stopped starting new builds. Fix: 1. In deploy/claude-headless.sh: when run headless (no attached client) close the tmux session ~2 minutes after `claude -p` exits (keep the log files), instead of waiting a day. If someone is attached, keep the old wait-for-Enter. 2. Wherever the agent cap …
